subject: AWS co-sell & marketplace listing readiness for MerchantBridge
messages:
From: Dustin Lee <dustin.lee@merchantbridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS co-sell intro & marketplace listing readiness for MerchantBridge

Hi Vanessa / Laura,

MerchantBridge is preparing for a Q2 procurement push with a target to go live on the AWS Marketplace for our payments orchestration product. Our AWS account team suggested we engage Redwood for co-sell and marketplace listing readiness — they specifically called out Redwood's marketplace experience and co-sell playbook.

High level:
- Company: MerchantBridge (SaaS B2B payments)
- Primary contact: Dustin Lee (me) / Rita Chen (procurement)
- Timeline: procurement window opens early April; ideally listing + co-sell enablement by end of May
- AWS details: we can share AWS Partner ID and account numbers after NDA (see attachment)

Can Redwood run an intake / readiness review and help us build a joint account plan with AWS? Would like a short intake call this week or next to align stakeholders and surface any documentation gaps (SOC2, data retention, container images, AMI packaging, billing owner).

I've attached a one-page contract summary and our expected procurement cadence.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

—Dustin

On Fri, Mar 12, 2027 at 09:05 AM Dustin Lee <dustin.lee@merchantbridge.com> wrote:
> MerchantBridge is preparing for a Q2 procurement push ...

We'd be happy to run an intake and build a joint account plan with AWS. Our typical first step is a 30–45 min intake where we map stakeholders, confirm the AWS sales/regional contacts, and run a short marketplace readiness checklist. I attached our MA Plan template and a readiness checklist to speed this up.

Proposed times for an intake call (30 mins):
- Tue 16 Mar, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 16 Mar, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed 17 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, share a couple windows that do. For the intake please have: AWS Partner ID, AWS account ID(s), primary procurement contact (Rita), and any current compliance artifacts (SOC2 report, data retention policy).

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Karthik (technical mapping) and Laura (co-sell ops) to capture any security/compliance asks and to coordinate the AWS-side outreach. Expect a short follow-up with proposed owners and a HubSpot record link.

Thanks,

Vanessa / Laura — quick checklist from the technical side that we should surface in the intake: 

1) Compliance artifacts: SOC2 Type II, data retention policy, any PCI attestations (even if not storing PAN), privacy policy.
2) Packaging & delivery: Do they plan to publish as SaaS listing (SaaS Subscriptions) or AMI/container? Need details on image hosting and ECR registries.
3) Billing & contract owner: AWS and MerchantBridge billing contact + contract signatory (name/email).
4) Integration points: what endpoints will call Redwood (inference endpoints) and expected request volume / concurrency (tokens per second estimate).
5) Entitlement model: SSO / account mapping for marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace entitlements vs direct).

I'll assemble a short tech-readiness checklist and security evidence list (attached) we can share with their procurement team ahead of the intake call. If the intake is next Tue 16th @ 10 PT I'm available.

—Karthik
